doc.brief: The QGraphicsLayout class provides the base class for all layouts in Graphics View.
doc.index_brief: The base class for all layouts in Graphics View

QGraphicsLayoutItem * itemAt(int i) cons.brief: This pure virtual function must be reimplemented in a subclass of [QGraphicsLayout](xref:qt:QGraphicsLayout) to return a pointer to the item at index *i*.

bool isActivated() const.brief: Returns `true` if the layout is currently being activated; otherwise, returns `false`.

int count() const = 0.brief: This pure virtual function must be reimplemented in a subclass of [QGraphicsLayout](xref:qt:QGraphicsLayout) to return the number of items in the layout.

void activate().brief: Activates the layout, causing all items in the layout to be immediately rearranged.

void addChildLayoutItem(QGraphicsLayoutI.brief: This function is a convenience function provided for custom layouts, and will go through all items in the layout and reparent their graphics items to the closest...

void invalidate().brief: Clears any cached geometry and size hint information in the layout, and posts a [LayoutRequest](xref:qt:QEvent) event to the managed parent [QGraphicsLayoutItem](xref:qt:QGraphicsLayoutItem).

void removeAt(int index) = 0.brief: This pure virtual function must be reimplemented in a subclass of [QGraphicsLayout](xref:qt:QGraphicsLayout) to remove the item at *index*.

void setContentsMargins(qreal left, qrea.brief: Sets the contents margins to *left*, *top*, *right* and *bottom*.

void widgetEvent(QEvent *e).brief: This virtual event handler receives all events for the managed widget.
